title: Print-ready PDF and branded Smart Image
question: Can an AI agent make a branded PDF, poster or Smart Map Image?
answer: Yes, from a running GISMap page. gisMapOnline.print renders the Print Editor's templates and returns the file. Exports wait for the map and fail rather than return a blank or partial page. Agents never draw their own Smart Image.
triggers: Make a printable map of this data
Make a poster of this map

required.name: map
required.description: A running GISMap page with the map loaded.

optional.name: title
optional.description: The page title; the project title by default.

optional.name: pages
optional.description: current-view, or bookmarks for a PDF with one page per bookmark.

steps.action: Read llms.txt, this recipe and api/capabilities.json; note the engine and execution environment you actually have.
Open the map in a browser with WebGL, await gisMapOnline.ready, then call print.exportPdf or print.exportSmartImage with a template from print.templates().
Open the file and check the title, legend and QR target. Pass on any warnings.
Return the file with the live share link. If export fails, report the error code and return the link alone.

artifact.structure: A static page of the current map; a Smart Image also embeds the project.

outputs.notes: Importing the PNG restores the project.

verification: The page shows the requested map, title and legend
The QR opens the live map
smartImages.read restores the project and reports renderedBy: app
limitations: Needs a browser with WebGL; there is no hosted rendering.
Wall maps are capped at about 6000 pixels on the long side.
Static outputs keep no live GIS interaction.
recovery: In headless Chromium without WebGL, launch with --use-gl=angle --use-angle=swiftshader.
If a layer does not load, report it; use allowPartial only if the user agrees.
If export fails, return the live share link and the error code.

examples.title: California grape acreage poster
examples.prompt: Make a poster of California grape acreage.

dataset.label: USDA Census of Agriculture 2022 grape production (Esri)

checks: The link opens the map to print; the export itself runs in the page.
